changelog:
Claude Desktop gateway stability fix: reduces fake tool-result narration, continuation confirmation loops, readonly file-check placeholders, large-context stream timeouts, preserves image tool results, and avoids concurrent account overload that can trigger 429 retry storms.
Claude Desktop 接入稳定修复版：缓解伪造 Tool results、继续/确认循环、只读文件检查占位话术、大上下文流式超时，修复图片 tool_result 传递，并通过账号 in-flight 跟踪降低并发打爆同一账号导致 429 重试风暴的概率。
